entities.name: Savai
entities.description: One of Ikoria's three-color triome regions, an arid land of plains, canyons and caves ruled by prides of monster cats.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: The plane on which Savai lies.

entities.name: Snapdax
entities.description: The apex monster of Savai, a Cat-clade predator whose lair is in the Unundo.

entities.name: Egali
entities.description: A fertile, verdant plain in the lower elevations of Savai.

entities.name: The Argalith
entities.description: The largest single crystal in the world and central landmark of Egali.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: Fortified human stronghold built around the Argalith, destroyed in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Jal Korcha
entities.description: Monumental road extending thousands of miles across the continent from Drannith to Lavabrink.

entities.name: Unundo
entities.description: Vast swampy cave system beneath Savai that shelters humans and other vulnerable species.

entities.name: Glondo Gorge
entities.description: A bottomless vertical drop deep within the Unundo.

entities.name: Cat clade
entities.description: The dominant clade of monsters in Savai, hunting in coordinated prides.

events.summary: Drannith, once the invincible city, is destroyed in the New Phyrexian Invasion and lies in ruins.
events.quote: It was ultimately destroyed during the New Phyrexian Invasion , and now lies in ruins.

relations.quote: The lair of Snapdax , the apex monster of Savai, is located somewhere within the Unundo.
Savai is one of Ikoria's three-color triome regions
The fortified city of Drannith was originally constructed around this green crystal
